svg.title: ML SDK components: offline asset production and on-device integration
svg.desc: The original offline framework, asset pipeline, converter and dump tool connect to three on-device integrations: an application with Workload Library, an application with a VGF decoder, and Scenario Runner with emulation. Nested boxes show library use; the key identifies the original four component categories.
